rows.english: The rest of what your Cabrillo log declares about the entry. Sweepstakes also sends these on the air, as the precedence letter, so it will not start until you have picked one of each: ARRL counts 5 watts or less as QRP, 100 watts or less as low power, and anything above that as high power, and an entry using spots, a skimmer or a cluster is Single Operator Unlimited.
rows.chinese: 这些项目也是 Cabrillo 日志中的参赛申报信息。Sweepstakes 还会将其作为参赛类别代码字母在交换信息中发送，因此必须为每项作出选择才能开始。ARRL 将不超过 5 瓦归为 QRP、不超过 100 瓦归为低功率，更高归为高功率；使用通报、自动抄收系统（skimmer）或集群的单人参赛者归为 Single Operator Unlimited。
rows.previous: 你的卡布里略日志中的其他内容 扫瞄器还将这些作为优先字母发送到空中,所以在您选择了每个字母之前,它不会开始:ARRL计5瓦或以下为QRP,100瓦或以下为低功率,任何高于此的都为高功率,使用斑点的条目,滑动器或集群是单一操作员无限的.

rows.english: Winter Field Day takes QRP or LOW (its limit is 100 W PEP), and HIGH writes no CATEGORY-POWER line.
rows.chinese: Winter Field Day 仅接受 QRP 或 LOW（功率上限为 100 W PEP）；选择 HIGH 时不会写入 CATEGORY-POWER 行。
rows.previous: 冬季战地日需要QRP或LOW(其限制为100 WPEP),HI不写类别-POWER线.

rows.chinese: 竞赛日志联系邮箱
rows.previous: 比赛日志的电子邮件

rows.english: Goes on the EMAIL line of the Cabrillo log you export for a contest whose log has one (the CQ contests), so the sponsor can reach you about your entry. The NAME line is your operator name from the Station tab. Leave it blank to leave the line out.
rows.chinese: 用于填写 Cabrillo 日志的 EMAIL 行，仅在比赛模板包含此字段时导出（例如 CQ 系列比赛），供主办方联系本台。NAME 行使用“电台”标签页中的操作员姓名。留空则省略该行。
rows.previous: 在 Cabrillo 日志的 EMAIL 线上, 您要导出一个竞赛的日志( CQ 竞赛) , 这样赞助商就可以联系您 。 命名线是您从车站标签中的操作员名 。 留空以离线.

rows.chinese: 参赛组别
rows.previous: 条目类

rows.english: The class the sponsor scores your entry in, from this contest's own rules, written on the ENTRY-CLASS line of the Cabrillo log. In the Illinois QSO Party a club running more than one transmitter at once enters UNLIMITED, and the high and low power classes split at 100 watts PEP. To certify a QRP entry, pick QRP under Power category.
rows.chinese: 主办方按本次比赛规则计分的组别，写入 Cabrillo 日志的 ENTRY-CLASS 行。Illinois QSO Party 中，俱乐部同时使用多台发射机应选 UNLIMITED；高低功率以 100 瓦 PEP 为界。如需申报 QRP，请在“功率类别”中选择 QRP。
rows.previous: 赞助商的分数是从本场比赛的规则中得来的 在卡布里略日志的ENTRY-CLASS线上 在伊利诺伊州QSO党一个俱乐部同时运行一个以上的发射机进入UNLIMITED,高低功率等级以100瓦PEP分拆. 为验证一个QRP条目,在Power类别下选择QRP.

rows.chinese: 俱乐部
rows.previous: 俱乐部

rows.english: Your contest club, for the CLUB line of the Cabrillo log when the contest's rules have one (the CQ contests, the Illinois QSO Party). Spell out the club's full name, as CQ asks. Leave it blank to leave the line out.
rows.chinese: 参赛俱乐部名称，用于比赛规则要求的 Cabrillo CLUB 行（如 CQ 系列比赛、Illinois QSO Party）。请按 CQ 要求填写俱乐部全名。留空则省略该行。
rows.previous: 你们的比赛俱乐部,在比赛规则有规定时 CLUB的CLUB赛道QSO政党。 如CQ所问,拼出俱乐部的全名. 留空以离线.

rows.chinese: 其他操作员
rows.previous: 其他运营商

rows.english: The OPERATORS line of the Cabrillo log lists everyone who was set as Operator at the key when they logged a contact. Add anyone else here, as callsigns separated by spaces or commas.
rows.chinese: Cabrillo 日志的 OPERATORS 行会列出所有录入交信时被设为当前操作员的人。如需补充其他操作员，请在此填写呼号，用空格或逗号分隔。
rows.previous: Cabrillo日志的OPERTORS线列出所有在登录联系人时被设定为密钥操作员的人. 在此添加其他任何人, 作为空格或逗号分隔的调用符 。

rows.chinese: 多人操作组别
rows.previous: 多操作类

rows.english: Which multi-operator class you are entering
rows.chinese: 选择多人操作参赛组别
rows.previous: 您要进入的多操作类

rows.english: How many signals your multi-operator entry puts on the air at once, in the classes this contest's sponsor scores: ONE is one at a time (Multi-One, Multi-Single), TWO is Multi-Two, UNLIMITED is Multi-Multi, and LIMITED is the ARRL VHF contests' Limited Multioperator. It goes on the CATEGORY-TRANSMITTER line of the Cabrillo log, with the OPERATORS line the sponsor needs from a multi-operator entry. Nexus marks every contact as transmitter 0, so add the second transmitter's contacts to a Multi-Two log before you send it.
rows.chinese: 选择多人参赛电台同时发射的信号数，按主办方组别划分：ONE 表示同一时间仅一个信号（Multi-One／Multi-Single），TWO 为 Multi-Two，UNLIMITED 为 Multi-Multi，LIMITED 为 ARRL VHF 比赛的 Limited Multioperator。此项写入 Cabrillo 的 CATEGORY-TRANSMITTER 行，多人参赛还需填写 OPERATORS 行。Nexus 将每条交信标为发射机 0，因此提交 Multi-Two 日志前，还需合入第二台发射机的交信记录。
rows.previous: 您的多操作者条目立即显示多少个信号,在本届比赛的赞助者分数中:一是一(多一,多单),二是多双(多双),ULIMITED是多双,LIMITED是ARRL VHF的有限多操作者. 它在卡布里略日志的分类-TRANSMITER线上, 与OPERATORS线 赞助商需要从多操作器条目。 Nexus将每个联系人标记为发射机0,因此在发送前将第二个发射机的联系人添加到一个多双日志中.

rows.chinese: 附加组别
rows.previous: 重叠

rows.english: Which overlay category you are also entering
rows.chinese: 同时参加的附加组别
rows.previous: 您正在输入的覆盖类别

rows.english: An extra category the sponsor scores beside your entry, for the CATEGORY-OVERLAY line, if you qualify under its rules (CQ's overlays are for single operators). For Rookie and Youth, CQ asks for the date you were first licensed or your birth year in the soapbox.
rows.chinese: 符合主办方规则时可另外参加的组别，写入 CATEGORY-OVERLAY 行（CQ 的附加组别适用于单人参赛）。参加 Rookie 或 Youth 时，CQ 要求在参赛感言中填写首次持照日期或出生年份。
rows.previous: 赞助商的分数是附加于您条目的类别, 对于类别- OverLAY 线, 如果您符合其规则( CQ 的重叠是针对单个操作者的) 。 对于Rookie和YouTube,CQ询问你第一次获得许可的日期或者你的出生年份在肥皂盒.

rows.chinese: 邮寄地址
rows.previous: 邮件地址

rows.english: Where the sponsor can mail a certificate or plaque, for the ADDRESS lines of the Cabrillo log: the street here, one line each, and the rest in the boxes below. A part the sponsor's template has no line for goes on one more ADDRESS line, the way its template writes it. Leave it blank to leave the address out. Remote never sees it.
rows.chinese: 供主办方邮寄证书或奖牌，写入 Cabrillo 的 ADDRESS 各行。此处按行填写街道地址，其余信息填入下方对应栏。若主办方模板没有某个地址部分的专用行，则按模板方式另写一行 ADDRESS。留空则不导出地址。Remote 无法查看这些信息。
rows.previous: 在赞助商可以邮寄证书或牌照的地方,为Cabrillo日志的ADDRESS线:这里的街道,各一行,其余的放在下面的框中. 赞助商的模板没有一条线, 把地址留空 遥控器永远看不到它。

rows.chinese: 邮寄城市
rows.previous: 邮寄城市

rows.chinese: 邮寄地址的州或省
rows.previous: 邮寄状态或省份

rows.chinese: 邮政编码
rows.previous: 邮政编码

rows.chinese: 邮寄国家或地区
rows.previous: 邮寄国

rows.chinese: 频段类别
rows.previous: 带状类别

rows.english: Which band category you are entering
rows.chinese: 选择参赛频段类别
rows.previous: 您输入的乐队类别

rows.english: ALL for an all-band entry, or the one band a single-band entry is entered on, for the CATEGORY-BAND line of the Cabrillo log. A single-band entry still logs every contact, other bands included, and the sponsor scores only the band named here. In the CQ contests a multi-operator entry is ALL. Leave it unset to leave the line out.
rows.chinese: 全频段参赛选择 ALL，单频段参赛选择相应频段，此项写入 Cabrillo 的 CATEGORY-BAND 行。单频段参赛仍会记录其他频段的全部交信，但主办方只对所选频段计分。CQ 系列比赛中的多人参赛必须选择 ALL。未设置则省略该行。
rows.previous: Cabrillo日志的BAND类条目。 一个单波段条目仍然记录每个联系人,包括其他乐队,赞助商只给这里命名的乐队打分. 在CQ比赛中,一个多操作员条目是ALL. 留其未定以离线.

rows.chinese: 参赛感言
rows.previous: 肥皂盒

rows.english: Your comments on the contest, for the SOAPBOX lines of the Cabrillo log. Each line you type is a line there, and a long one is wrapped to fit. The California QSO Party asks for its award lines here (YL, YOUTH, MOBILE, NEW CONTESTER…). Leave it blank to leave it out.
rows.chinese: 对本次比赛的感想或说明，写入 Cabrillo 的 SOAPBOX 各行。每行输入对应一行，过长会自动换行。California QSO Party 要求在此填写奖项申报行（YL、YOUTH、MOBILE、NEW CONTESTER 等）。留空则省略。
rows.previous: 你对比赛的评语 卡布里略日志的SOAPBOX线 你打的每条线都是一条线 一条长的线是包起来的 加利福尼亚州 QSO Party在此要求其奖项(YL, YouTH,MOBILE,新背景. 留空而别.

rows.chinese: 本台竞赛交换信息
rows.previous: 您的站点数据

rows.english: What your station sends when a contest asks for it. Fill in the ones your contest uses — a QSO party wants your county or your state, Sweepstakes wants your check. Nothing here is guessed: an exchange that goes on the air has to be one you typed.
rows.chinese: 本台在比赛要求时发送的信息。请填写所参加比赛需要的字段：QSO Party 需要县或州，Sweepstakes 需要首次持照年份的后两位。这里不会自动猜测任何值，实际发出的交换信息必须由你填写。
rows.previous: 比赛时你站会发出什么 填入您参赛时使用的内容—— a QSO 党要你的郡或州,斯威普斯要你的支票。 这里没有东西是猜到的: 播出的交换必须是你输入的。

rows.chinese: 县
rows.previous: 县

rows.english: Your county, abbreviated the way the QSO party abbreviates it (Franklin is FRAN). Only in-state entries send this.
rows.chinese: 本台所在县，按相应 QSO Party 的规则缩写（例如 Franklin 为 FRAN）。仅州内参赛方发送此项。
rows.previous: 你的县, 缩写的方式 QSO party abreviated it(弗兰克林是FRAN). 只有州内条目发送此消息.

rows.chinese: 州或省
rows.previous: 州或省

rows.english: Where your station is for this contest: your state, province or territory, two letters. This is not your ARRL section — Western New York is WNY as a section and NY as a state, and a QSO party wants the state. It is separate from the Station tab's State, the one your everyday macros send, so a portable or mobile entry can put here where it is operating.
rows.chinese: 本台参加此次比赛的操作地点，以两个字母表示州、省或地区。此项不是 ARRL 分区，例如纽约西部的分区为 WNY，州为 NY，QSO Party 要求发送州。此设置独立于“电台”标签页中供日常宏使用的“州”字段，便于便携或移动参赛时填写实际操作地点。
rows.previous: 你所在的站点是参加这场比赛的:你的州,省或地区,有两个字母. 这不是你的ARRL区——纽约西部是WNY区,纽约是州,QSO党要国家。 它与车站的状态是分开的, 你每天的宏发送的, 所以一个便携式或移动式的入口可以放在这里 它运行。
